title: GeyserCon
description: Modifies the Endercon datapack to stay within the Vanilla height limit.
body:
GeyserCon edits the Endercon datapack to stay within the Vanilla height limit.


_This datapack modifies the Endercon datapack. All credit to Endercon, and it's creator, Walls._
Endercon can be found [here](https://modrinth.com/datapack/endercon).

**Why?**
Because if you run a server with GeyserMC with Endercon, you will notice how blocks above the vanilla height limit are invisible to Bedrock players due a hardcoded height limitation, that GeyserMC can't modify. This solves that problem by changing some of Endercons generation algorithims to stay within the vanilla limit.

**Important...**
This datapack does NOT replace Endercon. Think of it like an addon to it. You still need the original [Endercon datapack](https://modrinth.com/datapack/endercon), and this datapack.
